model.source: client: SimpleChar_t::CalculateLife, AttackUtils_c::CalculatePowerRating/CalculateRawDamage; tweaks RDB 1000516; player defaults from the recorded original session

formulas.life: floor(((Level*HealthPerLevel + MinifigureLife) + LifeAdjust) * LifeMultiplier + 0.5); LifeMultiplier = prod(1 + StatMultiplier%/100)
formulas.power_rating: (int(PowerBaseFig*Level*MinifigureStarFactor) + PowerRatingAll + PowerRating[dt]) * (PowerEffectMin + MinifigureLevel*PowerEffectPerLevel) * GlobalPowerModifier; dt 1000..1004 -> PowerRating1..4,5
formulas.raw_damage: power_rating * AbilityMod * FinalDamageMultiplier * (1 + V*(2r-1)), r in [0,1), V = AttackUtils_DamageFlagVariance
